note: Sioux County Conservation park on the SW edge of Hawarden, on a 90-acre lake complex beside the Big Sioux River. Two campgrounds about 500 m apart: Eagle View on a peninsula with water on three sides, and Meadowlark on the lake's north shore. Swimming beach, boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $24-26, entrance, 35 sites, 50 amp, season, FCFS mix; reservation fee 4 -> 5 ($29/$31 online); facilities added. Waterfront lead up to lakefront.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (UP, lakeview -> lakefront): the water is the park's own lake, 90 acres of surface water across its basins per the county, well over the 5-acre line, not the Big Sioux River. Eagle View (imagery 42.9916,-96.5001; 16 sites): the east-row pads back toward the shore with the loop road on their landward side, about 15-40 m of open grass to the water; county: 'surrounded by water on 3 of the 4 sides'; 'all sites are back onto'. Apron open, a small fishing jetty only. Meadowlark south row (about 10 sites): pads along the lake's north shore with the loop road on the landward side, about 20-30 m to the water through a thin line of shoreline trees and shrubs; that row is filtered, the north row (across the road and the grass) is not on water. Both read off leaf-off imagery at about 0.4 m/px; no official site photos found. Stored evidence should be rewritten if AWH takes it.

PIN: stored 42.9955,-96.4985 lands just in the lake off Meadowlark's south row, about 90 m from Meadowlark's centre (42.9963,-96.4983), under the 250 m line. Eagle View is about 500 m south with its own loop; same park and entrance road, not a split.

Meadowlark's page gives online water/electric as $26 where Eagle View's gives $29; I took Eagle View's since $5 matches the full-hookup step ($26 -> $31 on both, and site 15 quotes $31). Reservation_fee is per night here, not per booking. Dump location not stated on these pages beyond 'Dump station'.
